finding_summary: No P0, P1 or P2 findings. No P3 findings.

run_001_preservation_and_negative_contro.negative_probe: The same marker-only generator applied to the preserved run_001 RTL fails xvlog because the aggregate USER hook declarations and consumers are absent. This reproduces the run_001 P1 finding rather than retroactively invalidating it.

contract_and_structure.required_user_markers: 14 of 14, exactly once and in frozen order
contract_and_structure.marker_only_generation: passed; independent unified diff shows all changed hunks within USER marker bodies

extension_path_audit.recognized_decode: user_opcode_known_w feeds aggregate opcode_known_w consumed by CHECK_COMMAND
extension_path_audit.legality: two in-range distinct logical bank operands are required before any array-indexed acquire
extension_path_audit.eligibility: both operand banks must be not busy and the capacity-one user executor must not already be pending
extension_path_audit.request_protocol: m_user_cmd_valid depends on ISSUE state/opcode/fault state and not on ready; both bank payload fields remain stable from registered command_r through backpressure
extension_path_audit.issue_commit: user_request_fire_w is valid-and-ready; aggregate request_fire_w alone advances PC; both banks receive opcode 3 in user_bank_acquire_w in the same acceptance cycle
extension_path_audit.pending_and_end_drain: user_pending_r sets on fire, feeds user_pending_any_w and aggregate pending_any_w, and therefore blocks END/error terminal state until completion
extension_path_audit.completion: stored legal bank identities must both match; one accepted completion pulses release for exactly those two banks and clears pending
extension_path_audit.faults: mismatched/spurious completion raises response fault without release; matching error completion releases both owned banks then reaches executor error; inconsistent user fire is guarded by the aggregate response-fault check
extension_path_audit.same_bank_behavior: a busy operand stalls the current PC with no request valid or lookahead
extension_path_audit.fixed_coexistence: a nonconflicting fixed MM2S remains independently pending while opcode 3 issues and completes
extension_path_audit.bounds_safety: command bank indices are range-checked before busy/acquire indexing; completion releases only stored identities from a previously legal accepted command

independent_extension_fault_supplement.verifier_harness_diagnostics: The first supplemental elaboration attempt was preserved after a verifier-only loop-index multiple-driver error. A second compile/elaboration succeeded. The xsim -runall launcher then raised a tool Tcl exception; the exact successful snapshot was executed directly with xsimk, matching the repository runners. Neither diagnostic was a DUT failure.

verilator.generated_extension_rtl: passed with only DECLFILENAME caused by the generated temporary filename

vivado_ooc.timing_exceptions: Hold-only false paths cover unplaced external data input and output ports. Internal register-to-register hold remains timed; the reported worst hold path is pc_r_reg[5]/Q to pc_r_reg[5]/D.
vivado_ooc.warnings: Five defined-unused upper error-code bits are constant; empty blackbox query and OOC connectivity-coverage warnings are nonfunctional and accurately scoped.

scope_and_limitations.validated: Reusable control template, fixed END/MM2S/S2MM infrastructure, and one capacity-one two-bank marker-only opcode-3 extension fixture.
residual_risks: Every real extension still needs its own contract, simulation, lint and OOC evidence.
The generated opcode-3 probe was compiled, linted and simulated but was not the netlist synthesized by the base-template OOC run.
The 0.079 ns OOC hold margin is positive but small and uses an unplaced external-clock context; integration timing must be rerun.
The extension probe supports one user command outstanding; richer executor capacity requires a bounded pending-identity implementation in USER regions.
not_validated: AXI BRAM Controller or address assignment
